meetings.title: Annual portfolio review completed
meetings.summary: Annual portfolio review with Board Trustee David Mitchell on the US Core Equity allocation, with discussion of the in-flight World Dividend Growers mandate. Mitchell wants Callan's read before progressing.

decisions.text: Hold the World Dividend Growers decision pending consultant feedback.

action_items.text: Await consultant (Callan) feedback on the dividend mandate

transcript_excerpt.speaker: David Mitchell
transcript_excerpt.text: We'll wait for Callan's view before the board takes a position.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Tom Brennan
transcript_excerpt.text: Understood - I'll coordinate with Callan and report back.

meetings.title: On-site portfolio review
meetings.summary: On-site portfolio review with David Mitchell. Confirmed positioning of the US Core Equity allocation; relationship healthy with no action required.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: David Mitchell
transcript_excerpt.text: Good session - the book looks well positioned.

meetings.title: Met at Annual Institutional Forum
